---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill when building or editing website pages for a luxury bio-active terrarium and micro-fauna studio in Pakistan.
---
1. Brand name is "Moss & Micro" with the tagline "Living miniature ecosystems, curated for modern Pakistani homes."
2. Tone of voice is refined, calm, botanical, and informative in polished English tailored to discerning buyers.
3. Background must be warm parchment `#F6F4EE`, card surfaces `#ECE7DC`, and primary accents deep forest moss `#2C4230`.
4. Primary text must be rich charcoal `#1E241F`, secondary muted text `#5A645B`, and warm terracotta `#A65D3F` for highlights.
5. Use Google Fonts: 'Playfair Display' for headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body copy, labels, and pricing.
6. Every page must include a top navigation bar linking Home (`index.html`), Ecosystems (`catalog.html`), and Care Guide (`care.html`), plus a footer noting Lahore & Islamabad courier delivery.
7. Showcase every product card with clean, bright natural-light botanical photography, container dimensions in `cm`, and care difficulty badges.
8. Write all prices in Pakistani Rupees with commas and zero decimals, formatted as `PKR 18,500`.
9. Format dates as `DD MMM YYYY` (e.g., `23 Nov 2026`) and humidity/temperature ranges cleanly (e.g., `70–85% RH · 22–28°C`).
10. Never use neon colors, cluttered discount pop-ups, cartoon clip-art, or stock photos with watermarks.
